text: Problem: behavioral state decay §1 Introduction Long-horizon agent tasks unfold over many observations, actions and partial decisions, and agents fail in a recognisable way: they identify a requirement early and violate it later while fixing an unrelated bug; they see a command, parameter or implementation path fail and later retry a near-identical variant; they diagnose an error and later treat the same error as new ( §1 ).
